reproduced.violation: Board Outline to SMD Pad — Clearance Error in the same footprint

pcb.outline.foreign.scan.why: the offending object is a component child primitive; pcb_PrimitiveLine/Arc/Polyline.getAll() cannot enumerate it, so the layer-11 scan returns 0 owned primitives even while DRC reports 4 violations. Scan still works correctly for real layer-11 graphics (free outline is reported as free).

pcb.outline.foreign.delete.why: pcb_PrimitiveLine.delete([id]) returns true, but after pcb save + doc reload the object is present again (getPrimitivesBBox still returns a box for the same id) and DRC reports the same violation → the engine re-materialises the footprint graphic.

steps: python tools/zhigou_footprint_outline_diagnose.py  → names the defective designator, pads and object id
zhigou sch replace --id <SW1 primitiveId> --lcsc C2885180   (TS-1187A-B-E-B, no embedded outline)
zhigou doc open <pcb> ; zhigou pcb import-changes
zhigou pcb save ; zhigou doc reload <pcb> ; zhigou pcb drc

product_decision: the two connector actions are removed from the runtime action catalog: they must not be advertised as a repair until enumeration/deletion of component-owned board-outline graphics is actually supported by the host API
the supported path is diagnose + component/footprint-level replacement + save/reload/DCR re-verification, shipped as tools/zhigou_footprint_outline_diagnose.py
root cause stays in the library footprint; the library should not embed board-outline graphics
